title: Effect of High Frequency Chest Wall Oscillation Vests on Spirometry Measurements
brief_summary: The impact of high-frequency chest wall oscillation therapy on spirometry values (Forced Expiratory Volume, Forced Vital Capacity, Peak Expiratory Flow, Forced Expiratory Flow and Tidal Volume is investigated during use of several products and comparing to baseline values.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy subject, ages 18 - 50

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-ambulatory, diagnosed neuromuscular disorder, currently using any type of oscillation vest therapy, diagnosed co-morbid condition (i.e. lung cancer, other lung disorder or disease), currently enrolled in a medical research study, non-English speaking
